claim: Clockwork's Thirteenth-Hour Union Hall visibly applies and clears one automatic four-second local formation-tempo window while remaining distinct from the Shift-Bell Foundry.

matched_setup.map: Rooftops at the End of Tuesday

expected_visible_change: Within one twelve-second cycle, nearby allied formations gain XIII rings, chevrons, and x1.18 selection/battlefield status for four seconds; those markers then clear while the Union Hall remains ordinary infrastructure and Shift-Bell Foundry remains a separate card.
observed_sequence: settled selected-army baseline -> automatic Hall feed receipt -> active XIII clock ring, four squad rings, x1.18 labels, and selection receipt -> stable post-window selection and squads with shift markers cleared
typed_observation: The active frame exposed four affected formations, THIRTEENTH HOUR x1.18 in the selected-army panel, XIII x1.18 over affected squads, SHIFT CHANGE x1.18 above the Hall, and a four-formation feed receipt. The confirmed settled frame removed formation and selection markers. The Expand rack simultaneously showed Z XIII Thirteenth-Hour Union Hall and B XII Shift-Bell Foundry, proving the roles remain distinct.
named_seams: No rolling visual buffer was exposed, so exact sub-frame animation cadence remains UNKNOWN; repeated screenshots and semantic polling prove the bounded state sequence.

The first post-window screenshot caught stale HUD pixels even though semantic selection state had cleared; it was rejected, a stable eight-sample quiet interval produced the confirmed frame, and the rejected exact path was deleted.
The externally owned PID 20208 serves current v0.16 static assets but its in-memory health and launcher metadata remains v0.14 until an allowed restart seam is available.
next_cheapest_test: A future hardware/rolling-capture hand can measure exact frame cadence; no further still-frame test is needed for this four-second state transition.
